label: accepted

evidence.V1: Curved ringed trunk with a 7-frond drooping crown reads as a palm from front, three-quarter, silhouette and top (star of fronds); clear at 64 px.
evidence.V2: Big (crown spread), medium (curved banded trunk, root collar) and small (3 coconuts, serrated frond edges, two-tone midribs) are all present and readable.
evidence.V3: Confident stylised proportions: gentle trunk curve, oversized arching fronds, chunky root collar.
evidence.V4: Frond edges and the root collar carry a consistent soft bevel that catches a light rim in the frond close-up; trunk rings are clean steps.
evidence.V5: Frond, crown and trunk close-ups shade cleanly with no pinches, seams or z-fighting; only the low-segment trunk outline shows slight polygonal stepping (geometry, not a shading artifact).
evidence.V6: Leaf green in two values (midrib split) plus bark brown in two values for rings and darker coconuts; disciplined, good contrast; autumn/frost colourways swap cleanly.
evidence.V7: 1812 tris vs tree target 2000 (ceiling 5000): at target.
evidence.V8: One vertex-colour material, smooth weighted shading, value-banded palette and bevelled forms consistent with the kit.
evidence.V9: Studio line: Anchored, Hull collision (trunk-only cylinder option), CanTouch off, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre: correct.

evidence.V1: Curved banded trunk under a drooping frond crown reads as a palm in front, three-quarter and silhouette; top view is a clear seven-frond star with a coconut hub.
evidence.V2: Clear tiers: big trunk and crown mass, medium individual fronds and trunk bands, small coconuts under the crown.
evidence.V3: Slender curved trunk, wide drooping serrated fronds and small coconut cluster give a confident stylised palm proportion.
evidence.V4: Fronds have soft thin edges with serrated outlines, but the trunk is low-segment with visible flat vertical facets and a jagged outline, so edge treatment is inconsistent.
evidence.V5: Trunk-rings close-up shows stray vertical faceting along the trunk; crown close-up (flat) shows a frond tip slicing through a neighbouring frond near the hub.
evidence.V6: One foliage hue in 2 values (two-tone fronds) plus bark brown secondary in 2 values; autumn and frost colourways keep the same discipline.
evidence.V7: 1812 tris vs tree target 2000 - under target.
evidence.V8: Single LF_VertexColor material and correct foliage + bark palette, but the faceted low-poly trunk does not match the smooth weighted-normal organic shell standard.
evidence.V9: Studio line: Anchored, Hull collision (trunk-only cylinder option noted), CanTouch off, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre.

evidence.V1: Unmistakable palm from every view: curved banded trunk with drooping frond crown in front/3-4/silhouette, 7-point star of fronds from the top.
evidence.V2: Clear tiers: big frond crown, medium curved trunk with alternating ring bands, small coconuts clustered under the crown and notched frond edges with a two-tone midrib.
evidence.V3: Confident stylised proportions: gently S-curved tapering trunk, root flare, broad fronds that arch and droop at the tips.
evidence.V4: Frond edges are thin with soft rounding while the trunk shows visible vertical polygon facets between rings (trunk-rings close-up); the bevel language is not consistent between parts.
evidence.V5: Mostly clean, but a dark patch shows near the tip of the back-right frond (3/4 view, all colourways) suggesting a folded/backfacing frond tip, and the trunk has visible facet banding in studio light.
evidence.V6: Leaf green in two values (light midrib half, dark half) plus bark brown in two values and a dark coconut; autumn and frost colourways stay disciplined.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material, foliage hue + bark brown secondary, smooth fused shells; matches the nature kit.
evidence.V9: Anchored, Hull collision (trunk-only Cylinder if fronds should not block), CanTouch off, SmoothPlastic, MeshPart.Color white, origin bottom-centre.

artifacts: Slight polygonal stepping on the trunk outline in the trunk-rings close-up
Stray vertical faceting on the trunk (PalmTree_01_close_trunk_rings_studio.png)
Frond tip intersecting a neighbouring frond at the crown hub (PalmTree_01_close_crown_flat.png)
Dark patch near the tip of the back-right frond (folded or backfacing tip) visible in 3/4 and colourways
Visible vertical facet banding on the trunk
top_fixes: Add a couple more radial segments (or bulge each ring slightly) so the trunk outline is rounder and the rings read as stacked collars
Vary frond lengths/angles slightly so the crown is less evenly radial from the top view
Make the coconut cluster a touch larger so it reads at 64 px
Raise trunk radial segments or apply weighted normals so the trunk shades smooth and its outline is not jagged
Offset frond roots in height so no frond slices through its neighbour at the hub
Give trunk rings a slight geometric step or bulge so they catch light, not just colour bands
Fix the back-right frond tip (unfold / recalc normals) so no dark patch shows
Add 2-4 more radial segments to the trunk or smooth its normals to remove facet banding
Give frond edges a slight thickness/rounded rim so they match the trunk's edge treatment
